name: Rosenbaum Law Group, PC
about: Rosenbaum Law Group works from Northeast Broadway and opens its site with an explanation of when somebody has an injury case at all, which is a more useful first page than most.

A free consultation, published. Its site is one of two in this market that passes Core Web Vitals outright, at 99 on PageSpeed. It states no fee model in terms we could record and names no attorney on the pages we could reach.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

json_ld_descriptions: An injured person may have a personal injury case when another person or business was careless, inattentive, or didn’t do what they were supposed to do, and that negligence caused the person’s injuries. The attorneys at Rosenbaum Law Group are experts in holding people, business, and their insurance companies accountable for their negligent or intentional actions. Our lawyers have a strong record of successful trial experience. Rosenbaum Law Group achieved one of the largest personal injury verdicts in Oregon history. Our history of success lets insurance companies know what they are up against, and our stellar reputation with plaintiff and defense lawyers alike (some of the top attorneys in the state refer personal injury matters to us) put us in the best position to negotiate a full and fair settlement on your behalf or take your case to trial when necessary for the best result. If you or a loved one has suffered harm at the hands of another, call our experienced Portland personal injury lawyers for dedicated expertise and assistance with your claim.
